title: Saved drafts persist and are readable only by their author

outcome: Drafts live only in the browser; nothing reaches /api/drafts and a reload loses them.
A saved draft persists, and its author can reopen it after a reload.
forbid: no new migration — the drafts table already carries every column and access rule
no change to the public POST /api/drafts request shape

why: make test red: the route trusted the access policy instead of filtering; another user still got rows

evidence: make lint + make test green; the author reads their draft back, another user gets 404

outcome: A shared-workspace member sees a draft only once its author publishes it; before that, zero rows, not a filtered count.
forbid: no admin read path — widening it here crosses a privacy boundary this goal has not cleared
